title: Private quiet apt in very hip area!
description:
Located in one of Nashville's hottest neighborhoods this 1br apartment is the private back extension of the house.  Short walk to fabulous Five Points East Nashville where you'll find some of the best restaurants, bars, shops, galleries and happenings Nashville has to offer.  Around the corner from groceries, coffee shops and more stores and restaurants.  10 min from airport and 5 min from downtown.  
Great spot for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers or small families!

The space
There is a very comfortable futon in the living room area, great for that 3rd or 4th guest.  Kitchen is fully stocked so cook away.  Kroger grocery store is just around the corner.  
You also have a small private out door space with a fire pit.

Guest access
The apartment is private and fully stocked.  There is a shared laundry room located on the basement floor of the house.  You access it via its own private entrance.

Other things to note
This AirBnB has a legal permit and is fully insured.
